title: Give a little
description: Thoughtful gifts, candlelit evenings, and beautiful little things that make it feel like Christmas.
announcement: Make it a season to remember
sub: For the host, the homebody, and everyone you love.
featureText: Set the table. Light the candles. Make room for the people who matter. Our collection brings a little warmth to every gathering.
products: A beautifully packed candle, linen napkins, and spice collection for your favorite host.
A warm amber candle to bring a soft glow to winter evenings.
A textured sand-colored vase with dried stems for a naturally beautiful home.
Six soft washed-linen napkins for a table worth gathering around.
A richly grained wooden board for festive bites and generous sharing.
Four aromatic spice jars, beautifully boxed for holiday cooking.
